name: Modern UI - V
description:
Modern UI - V (现代化UI V版) is an UNOFFICIAL FORK of Modern UI by BloCamLimb, adding VulkanMod compatibility for Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric.
Upstream expects an OpenGL device, which VulkanMod replaces entirely, so this build re-routes UI rendering onto Vulkan and fixes the off-screen UI artifacts on that backend. Everything else -- the UI, fonts, widgets and API -- is unchanged.
All credit for Modern UI belongs to BloCamLimb. This is NOT an official build: report issues to this fork, not upstream.
Distributed under LGPL-3.0-or-later; bundles HarmonyOS Sans SC fonts (license included).
